text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: At the Queen of Hearts' castle, the group was engaged in a brawl with those who had been corrupted by the Black King.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハートの女王の城で、
一行は黒の王に侵食された者たちと乱戦になっていた。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: UUUNYANYANYAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text: うーにゃにゃにゃにゃにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: D-DON'T COME ANY CLOSER, PLEASEEEE!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
こっちに来ないでくださ～い！

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Rascal 1
text_block_list.text: GWAAAAAHHH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐおぉぉぉ～～！！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Ugh... There's no end to this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう……
きりがないです～っ！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Leave this to us! Alice-chan, we're up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちに任せてください！
アリスちゃん、
いきますよ！

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: I'm ready anytime!
text_block_list.orig_text: いつでもいいわ！

text_block_list.name: Rino Alice
text_block_list.text: GOOOOOOOOOOOO!!
text_block_list.orig_text: いっけぇぇぇえ～～！！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: We did it! First up, we should regroup with Inori-chan and the others!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった！
まずはイノリちゃんたちと合流しましょう！

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Rascal 2
text_block_list.text: Hihihi! Long live the Black King!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヒヒッ！
　黒の王ばんざーい！！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with these guys all of a sudden?! Now that it's come to this, there's no other choice for me but to use the muscle-brained Kaya-pii way of negotiating... That is, punch them until they understand!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゅ、
急になんなんですかこいつら！
こうなったら、
脳筋カヤぴぃ流ネゴシエートしかないですね……
殴って分からせる、
です！！

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Rascal 2
text_block_list.text: Gugiiii!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐぎぃぃい！！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: My Minister, follow my example!
text_block_list.orig_text: 大臣もやるですよ！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: But I am~♪ ...Look at Lago.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やってるよ～？
……ラーゴがね♪

text_block_list.name: Lago
text_block_list.text: Gyao!
text_block_list.orig_text: ギャオッ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Sometimes you can also do things yourself, you know! Ugh... As always, you dragon tamers can be so lame!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
たまには自分でやりやがるですよ！
くうぅ～……
相変わらず、ドラゴン使いが荒すぎるですっ！！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Inori-chan! Homare-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
イノリちゃん！　
ホマレさん！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Yes, feel free to come in♪ Welcome to the Queen of Hearts' castle!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～い、
いらっしゃ～い♪
ようこそ、
ハートの女王の城へ～

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Is this really the time to be so carefree?! I'll have you all tell me what's going on at once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
のん気なこと言ってる場合ですか！？
おまえたち、状況を教えるですよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Let's see... the people corrupted by the Black King are attacking us so we're going "DOBAAH" to which they're going "Ugaah...". That's the gist of it! Right, Ayumi-chan!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーっと、
黒の王に侵食された人たちが
どばーっと襲いかかってきて、
うわぁーっってなってるの！
そうだよね！
　アユミちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: I-I've no idea what you just said, but I suppose it's more or less right...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よ、
よく分からないですけど、
大体合ってます……！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: THERE'S NO WAY ANYONE WOULD UNDERSTAND THAT EXPLANATION! ARE YOU STUPID OR WHAT!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな説明で分かるわけねーですよ！？
バカですか！？

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: I see~ In other words, the miasma that caused all of this is being controlled by a "Black King"~
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほどね～
つまり、あの瘴気は
黒の王っていうのが操ってるんだね～

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: How did you even understand that from all those random words she threw at us?!
text_block_list.orig_text: あんな適当な言葉からなにを理解したですか！？

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Anyway, for now, I'm relieved that everyone's okay~
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく、
みんな無事だったみたいで安心したよ～

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: As for us... We were on a journey to find a way back to our real world, but we were attacked by all sorts of bandits, you know? We had no choice... so we "persuaded" them to help us out♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たち、
元の世界に戻る方法を探す旅をしてたんだけど
色んな盗賊に襲われちゃってね～？
仕方がないから
『説得』して
協力してもらってたんだ～♪

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Persuaded... PERSUADED, SHE SAYS?! No, what happened was way more nefarious than a simple persuasion! I mean, does she even expect anyone to believe that kind of bogus story...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
説得……
説得ぅっ！？
いやあれは
説得というか
もっと邪悪な何かですよ！？
ていうかこんな話、
誰が信じると……

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: To think that you could turn a bunch of thieves into your allies just by persuading them... Homare-san, you're amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
盗賊さんたちを
説得だけで味方にしちゃうなんて……
ホマレさんはすごいですっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: As fellow guildmasters, I admire your example! Hey, hey, Homare-san, please make sure to teach me a lot of things next time we have the chance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
同じギルドマスターとして憧れちゃう！
ねえねえホマレさん、
今度色々教えてほしいな！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Hehehe~ That sounds good~♪ We'll take our time when that happens, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ～
いいよ～♪
今度じっくりと、
ね？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: TH-THESE FOOLS ARE SO NAIVE I CAN'T EVEN JOKE ABOUT IT!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
こいつら頭お花畑過ぎるです！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: ...Ahem. Well, that's about it... and also why we made this deserted castle our temporary base.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
コホン、
まあそんなわけで
この無人の城を根城にしてたわけですよ。

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Becoming the Queen of Hearts and her Minister in the process♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハートの女王様と
その大臣として、ね♪

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: So then... that rumor about the Queen of Hearts joining forces with the Black King is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
ハートの女王が
黒の王と手を組んでるっていうのは……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: AAAAHN?! Of course that's just a damn obvious lie. Who's even this Black King anyway?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～！？
　真っ赤な嘘に決まってるです。
そもそも
黒の王ってなんです？

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Maybe... the way we were "exploring" was seen as a little rough, so perhaps they believed we were ravaging this country instead~♪ But still, the Black King, huh~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ～っと
探索の仕方が荒っぽかったから、
この国を荒らしているように見られちゃったのかも～♪
それにしても、
黒の王、か～

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: I'm sure that he also had a part in having corrupted people spread bad rumors about the Queen of Hearts... that way, he'd be able to gather and deal with us in one fell swoop.
text_block_list.orig_text:
きっと、
支配した人間に
ハートの女王の悪い噂を流させて……
私たちが集まったところを
一気に片付けるつもりだったんだろうね。

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: I was aware that there was a certain evil covering this world, but... I wonder if he got a fast one on me☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
この世界を覆っている邪悪な存在には気付いてたんだけど……
これは一本取られちゃったかな☆

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Aside from that, O'Queen? It seems we're under siege because our forces are rebelling against us. What should we do～?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなわけで女王様？
反乱が起きて私たち、
包囲されちゃったんだけど～
どうしよっか～？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text:
"What should we do～?"
DON'T GIVE ME THAT CRAP! I'm just going to force my way through!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしよっか～？
　
じゃないですよ！
そんなもん、
強行突破に決まってるです！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I see! So you're going "DOKAAAN" and "GAAAN" at them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど！
　どかーんといって
がーん！　だね！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: That's right! It seems we're finally speaking the same language!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうです！
　おまえなかなか話が分かるですね！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, while you were busy having a very insightful chat, it seems more and more are coming our way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらほら、
そんなこと言ってる間に
どんどん押し寄せてきてるよ～？

text_block_list.name: Roughneck 3
text_block_list.text: LONG LIVE THE BLACK KINGGGG!!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 黒の王ばんざぁあああい！！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: S-Senpai! WATCH OUUTTTTTT!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
せ、
先輩！
　危な～い！

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: An attack from a complete blind spot...! The angle was perfect, too! Way to go, Ayumi♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
完全に死角からの攻撃……！
いい角度で入ったわね～
やるじゃない、アユミ♪

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: All right, the path's open! Now's our chanc-...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
道が開けましたよ！
今のうちに──！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: PIIYYIII?! WH-WH-WHAT'S GOING ON NOW?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぴいぃ！？
　ななな、
なんですか！？

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: This shaking... I'm pretty sure that earlier too...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この揺れ……
さっきも確か……！

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Rascal 2
text_block_list.text: Oooh...
text_block_list.orig_text: おお……

text_block_list.name: Roughneck 3
text_block_list.text: Ohh... Ohhhh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお……
おおぉ…………

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: All the people we took care of are suddenly standing up!
text_block_list.orig_text: やっつけた人たちが立ち上がってくるよ！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Hm? This is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん？　
これって……

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Rascal 2
text_block_list.text: The Black King awakens...
text_block_list.orig_text:
黒の王が
目覚める……

text_block_list.name: Roughneck 3
text_block_list.text: This world will fall into darkness... Hee hee!
text_block_list.orig_text:
世界が闇へと堕ちるんだぁ……
ヒヒッ！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: ...From over there, maybe?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あそこ、
かな～？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Oi, Boss! Why are you just staring off into the distance?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こら、ボス！
なにぼーっと遠くを見てやがるですか！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Homare-san? What in the world is-...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホマレさん？
　いったいなにが……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is this?! The scenery has changed...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんなのこれ！？
景色が変わって……！？

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: The world is sinking into darkness...! No way... I can't believe it has already been corrupted to such an extent!
text_block_list.orig_text:
世界が闇に染まっていく……！
そんな……
もうここまで侵食されてたなんて！

text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: PIII?! T-THAT... WHAT'S THAT WHICH JUST CAME OUT??!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぴぃっ！？
な、
なんか出てきたです！！？？

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: Everyone! That right there is the Black King... Jabberwocky!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな！
あいつが黒の王
・ジャバウォックよ！！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: You really have? That's kind of interesting~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなの？
それは興味深いな～

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Perhaps, an image of "evil" from our imagination has been embodied itself into this book~ Truly, what a peculiar world~
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかしたら、
私たちが想像する邪悪のイメージが、
この本の中で具現化されたのかもしれないね～
本当に不思議な世界だな～

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! What is this feeling...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっ……！
なんですか
この感じ……！？

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: It's disgusting...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
気持ち、
悪い……！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: This is the same bad feeling we've felt plenty of times before...! But... it's way stronger than any of those times we've faced it before...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これって
何度か感じてきた、
いやな感覚……！
でも、
今まで感じたものよりも、
全然強い……！！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Ugh! This is... a terrible miasma~ Even for me, it might be dangerous to be exposed to it for a long time~
text_block_list.orig_text:
っくう！
　これは……ひどい瘴気だね～
さすがの私も、
ずーっと浴び続けるのはきついかも～

text_block_list.name: Black King
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: The completion of the "Savior's Power" has not yet been reached...!
text_block_list.orig_text: まだ救世主の力は完全じゃないってのに……！

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: Even so, we have to do this!! Rino! We're going to hit the Black King with an arrow of light using all of our might!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、やるしかない！！
リノ！
　全力の光の矢を、
黒の王にぶつけるわよ！！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Yes! Alice-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！
アリスちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Rino Alice
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁああああああ～～！！！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Yay! An arrow of light!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったぁ！
　光の矢！！

text_block_list.name: Black King
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrr...
text_block_list.orig_text: グルルルゥ……

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: The arrow of light... The power of the savior... isn't working...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
光の矢が……
救世主の力が、
効かない……！？

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: Dammit...! So it really was too early as I expected...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ……！
やっぱり、まだ早かったか……！！

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: This is bad. As we're right now, we have no way to fight back against the Black King!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずいわね、
今のあたしたちじゃ
黒の王に対抗できない！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: It's coming, everyone! Watch out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
来るよ、みんな！
気を付けて！

text_block_list.name: Rino and the others
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAHHHHH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃぁああああー！！！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: O-Owowow...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いたた……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Th-That's some crazy power...
text_block_list.orig_text:
む、
むちゃくちゃな力だね……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: There won't be a next time if we get hit again...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
次やられたら、
ひとたまりもないです……！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: ONII-CHAN! It's too dangerous for you to step forward! Even if you were to take that next attack, Onii-chan, you'd...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃん！
　前に出たら危ないです！
今の攻撃、
お兄ちゃんだってもらってるのに！！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Kishi-kun, no...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士くん、
ダメ……！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Senpai... Please stop...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
先輩……
やめてください……！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Onii-san! Don't try to be playing hero right now! No matter how many lives you think you have, they won't be enough!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄さん、
無理はダメです！
そんなの命がいくつあっても足らないですよ！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Honestly speaking, we're quite in a pinch... This is a problem~
text_block_list.orig_text:
正直大ピンチ
だね……
困ったな～

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Rino. For coming to this world of mine, thank you so much. I'm glad I was able to meet a friend like you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねえリノ、
この世界に来てくれて
ありがとね。
あんたみたいな友達に出会えて
あたし、うれしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Alice-chan...?
text_block_list.orig_text: アリスちゃん……？

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: What's with that, you look like a pigeon that's been hit by a peashooter. I was just giving you my honest thanks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なによ、
鳩が豆鉄砲食ったみたいな顔して。
素直にお礼を言っただけなのに。

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: What's with you, Alice-chan...? Why are you suddenly bringing up heartfelt thanks at a time like this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんなんですかアリスちゃん……？
なんでこんなときに、
そんな話するんですか？

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: I'm going to unleash my full power as the savior with the next attack. I think it will serve as a distraction.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今からあたしの救世主の力を全開放するわ。
目くらましにはなると思う。

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: On your end, you'll all retreat so that you can regroup. Understood?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたはいったん引いて、
態勢を立て直すの。
分かったわね？

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: As I've said... what's with you?! Why are you talking about as if you're not going to retreat with us, Alice-chan?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、なんなんですか！？
どうしてアリスちゃんと一緒に態勢を立て直す話じゃないんですか！？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with this?! This sudden light is...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんです！？
　急に光が……！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Alice-chan...?! HEY, ALICE-CHAN!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アリスちゃん……！？
ねえ、
アリスちゃんっ！！

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: I'll leave the rest to you.
text_block_list.orig_text: 後のことは任せたわよ。

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: In order to defeat him, you'll need to further awaken your power as the savior. I kind of regret we'll not be able to discover it together...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつを倒すには、
救世主の力のさらなる覚醒が必要だわ。
一緒にそれを探せたらよかったんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry. I really am. But I'm sure that if it's you, you can do it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ごめんね。
本当に。
でも、
きっとあんたならできるわ。

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: You'll definitely be able to obtain the power of a true savior... I believe in you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
真の救世主の力を、
絶対に手にすることができるって……
あたし、
信じてるから。

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: Please, protect this world---! Rino...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お願い、
この世界を守って──
リノ──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The Black King appears, and the world inside the book becomes stagnant with the power of darkness. Alice's light envelops Rino and the others like a lamp.
text_block_list.orig_text:
黒の王が現れ、闇の力で瘴気によどんだ本の中の世界。
アリスの放つ光が、灯火のようにリノたちを包むのだった。
